sandbox_answers.q6_token_required: Boss must approve each item by providing the OWNER_APPROVED_EMAIL_SANDBOX_TOKEN=<action_id> token.
sandbox_answers.q7_real_sending_blocked: Yes. All SMTP and API calls are strictly stubbed, and any live execution is hard-locked.
sandbox_answers.q8_future_live_effect: If live email mode is unlocked in future milestones, it would trigger real SMTP sends to Thanh Hoa SMEs.
sandbox_answers.q9_audit_trail: Every sandbox write event is appended with a timestamp to email-action-ledger.json.
sandbox_answers.q10_live_email_fixes: To enable live emails, the owner must update policy kill switch configurations and provide the OWNER_APPROVED_LIVE_TOKEN.
